subject: Re: Kickoff: linear-eval as the portfolio's representation check — status
body:
Hi Anders, Jelena,

Status:

- First team migrated Apr 22 (two days early). Their old hand-rolled logistic-regression eval disagreed with linear-eval by up to 1.9pp on the same embeddings — traced to them never tuning L2; our optimal_l2_reg search settles it. Good ammunition for the standardization story.
- One subtlety worth documenting: when embedding counts aren't divisible by device count, the library zero-pads and relies on the train mask, but the migrating team's custom loader dropped the mask and quietly trained on padding. Linnea added a validation check that hard-fails on unmasked padding.

Risk: the distillation recipe is going slower than the eval work — my first students verify fine on linear eval but the recipe isn't turnkey yet, and 40% of my time is proving thin. May need Jelena to rebalance if Jun 12 is to include a distillation quickstart.

Efe
